Validation: POST /invoices with invalid NIF '12345678A' -> 422 with clear Spanish message; iva_rate=13 -> 422 'El tipo de IVA debe ser 0, 4, 10 o 21%'; empty line_items -> 422; empty description -> 422; valid payload (nif '12345678Z') -> 200 and GET /invoices/{id} confirms persistence. PUT /invoices/{id} on an anulada invoice -> 400. Anular with VeriFactu (company verifactu_enabled=true, mode='simulado', valid NIF): POST /invoices/{id}/anular returns {status:'anulada', verifactu:{huella:64-hex, status:'Anulación aceptada por la AEAT (simulado)', mode, csv, signed:false}}; GET /invoices/{id}.status == 'anulada'; 2nd /anular -> 400 'La factura ya está anulada.'; GET /invoices/{id}/pdf still returns application/pdf. For user WITHOUT verifactu on company, /anular still marks invoice anulada with verifactu=null. Dashboard exclusion: /dashboard?year=2025 ingresos does not increase when the newly-created invoice is annulled (v2<=v1). /annual-summary?year=2025 returns 200 and skips anuladas ({status:{$ne:'anulada'}} filter confirmed at server.py:783,887). IRPF suggestion: for autonomo w/ empty autonomo_start_date -> {suggested_rate:15,is_new_autonomo:false}; setting company.autonomo_start_date='2026-01-01' via PUT /company flips to {suggested_rate:7,is_new_autonomo:true}; tax_type='empresa' -> {suggested_rate:0}. AI assistant: POST /assistant/chat with empty message -> 400 'Escribe una pregunta.'; with '¿Qué IRPF pongo si soy autónomo nuevo?' -> 200 with reply containing '7' and session_id echoed; multi-turn with reused session_id -> 200 reply. AI invoice review: POST /invoices/review with bad draft -> {ok,issues:[],summary} JSON; clean draft -> {ok,...}. Frontend (Playwright, self-registered iter12ui_*@example.com, then platino-upgrade skipped since basico is enough for these flows): /registro -> auto-redirect to /configuracion; company-autonomo-start date field present, saved with 2026-01-01; /facturas Nueva factura dialog shows irpf-hint text with 'Aplicar 7%' apply-irpf-suggestion button (matches new-autonomo backend suggestion); saving with invalid NIF '12345678A' -> 422 in console + dialog stays open (no invoice created); review-ai button triggers ai-review-result block; fixing NIF to '12345678Z' + saving creates invoice; invoice-anular-2026-0001 button present; clicking (window.confirm auto-accepted) annuls -> row shows red 'Anulada' badge and edit/rectify/paid/anular icons are hidden (only PDF/email icons remain). Assistant widget: assistant-fab opens assistant-panel; typing question + assistant-send returns Spanish reply mentioning 15%/7%/actividad empresarial. No frontend console errors beyond the intentional 422. Verifactu certificate not exercised (per request, best-effort). Plan defaults untouched. Ephemeral users left in DB (TEST_iter12_user_*, TEST_iter12_novf_*, iter12ui_*).
critical_code_review_comments: server._validate_invoice uses `data.iva_rate not in (0, 4, 10, 21)`. Since iva_rate is a float pydantic field, 21.0 in (0,4,10,21) works via float==int equality, but this is fragile — if someone sends 21.5 by mistake it fails; consider explicit `float(data.iva_rate) in {0.0,4.0,10.0,21.0}` to make intent explicit.

server.anular_invoice at line 388 uses `.get('number','')` on the last verifactu-registered invoice, but the chained fingerprint for anulacion (compute_fingerprint_anulacion) doesn't use prev_number — only prev huella. prev_number is only used inside the RegistroAnterior XML. Fine, but noting the number is not part of the huella chain per VeriFactu spec (verified in verifactu_service.py:45-54).

server.anular_invoice writes `verifactu.anulacion` on the invoice doc but does NOT wrap the whole verifactu block for non-verifactu invoices (verifactu_result stays None). The response returns `verifactu: null` which the tests accept — but the frontend `Anulada` badge relies on status, not verifactu — good separation.

ai_service._chat uses model 'gpt-5.4' hardcoded. If the Emergent LLM key rotates model availability, this becomes a single point of failure — consider env-driven model name (AI_MODEL) with a fallback.

ai_service.review_invoice silently returns {ok:true,issues:[],summary:'No se pudo analizar...'} on JSON parse failure. This makes a broken AI look identical to a clean invoice to the client. Consider ok:false and severity:warning so the UI can flag 'IA no disponible'.

spanish_tax.irpf_suggestion uses datetime.now(timezone.utc).year — timezone.utc year is always safe, but for edge dates around new year in Madrid this could be off by one hour on Dec 31 late night. Marginal.
AssistantWidget generates a fresh session_id on mount (Date.now()+random). Reloading the page loses conversation context. If persistence is desired, store session_id in localStorage.

Invoices.js line 369-370 has a duplicate 'Eliminar' Button rendered twice back-to-back (see grep result: invoice-delete appears twice at lines 369 and 370). This causes a duplicate data-testid=`invoice-delete-<number>` which is a testing anti-pattern and produces two trash icons in the UI. Recommend removing one.
